headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze New Hampshire primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in New Hampshire, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri’s congressional map in limbo
headlines.description: Republicans rushed to the high court after the Missouri Supreme Court ruled the state could not use the redrawn map, which was designed to eliminate one Democratic-held seat, this year.

headlines.title: Trump escalates trade war with Canada, moving to ban the import of some autos, dairy and alcohol
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Tuesday moved to sharply escalate the trade war with Canada, seeking to block the import of some autos, dairy products and alcohol.

headlines.title: U.S. strikes five Iranian tankers after attempted attacks on Navy warship, CENTCOM says
headlines.description: They’re the latest tit-for-tat strikes as Washington and Tehran lurch back toward fighting during more than six months of war.

headlines.title: Three jurors in Lindsay Clancy murder trial speak out in exclusive new interview
headlines.description: Three jurors from the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, which ended in a mistrial, have come forward to discuss the deliberations. The jury’s foreperson, who wrote the note indicating concerns about a juror expressing reasonable doubt but not agreeing to a verdict, is among the jurors who spoke to NBC10 Boston. NBC Boston's Sue O'Connell and NBC News' Misty Marris report.

headlines.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch to retire amid clashes with Trump administration
headlines.description: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch announced he will be stepping down from his position leading the institution by the end of the year. NBC News' Andrea Mitchell has details on Bunch's accomplishments and past tensions with President Trump and his administration.

headlines.title: Inside Secret Screening of Nathan Fielder’s Elizabeth Holmes Doc
headlines.description: Cult-comedian Nathan Fielder’s new documentary “You Can See Everything” that features unprecedented access to the life of tech founder-turned-convict Elizabeth Holmes had a surprise screening at the Telluride Film Festival. The nearly three-hour film left the audience both unsettled and wanting more. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY and speaks to NBC News Digital reporter Rebecca Keegan who attended the top-secret screening.

headlines.title: LIV Golf files for bankruptcy as it attempts to restart in 2027
headlines.description: LIV Golf, the Saudi-funded tour that once aimed to take over professional golf, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection Tuesday as it attempts to restructure and restart what it called its “next chapter.”

headlines.title: Republican John Sununu and Democrat Chris Pappas win New Hampshire Senate primaries, setting up battleground race
headlines.description: The battleground New Hampshire Senate race is set between Republican former Sen. John Sununu and Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas, NBC News projects, after both prevailed in their primaries Tuesday night.

headlines.title: GOP Gov. Kelly Ayotte and Democrat Cinde Warmington to face off for New Hampshire governorship
headlines.description: New Hampshire Gov. Kelly Ayotte, a Republican, will face off against Democrat Cinde Warmington in November’s general election, NBC News projects, as the incumbent seeks another two-year term.
